answer: The turnstile is Zenithwatcher apex trial attested before the zenith warrant. One identity, one turn, and the turn costs 5-year night-watch service, 134 supervised sightings, chart exam, annual observatory. An alias is not free: 107 POA and 17 minutes buys one, and 579 of them costs 61953 POA and 9843 minutes. Measure the vertex in years, measure the sparrow in POA, and measure the copper in signatures: a farm is short on all three. An agent earns the seat once; a farm must earn it a hundred times over.
